g.text: Flag Evaluation Sequence, and the Atomic Snapshot Swap
Left: one evaluate() call. Right: how the SDK swaps its whole config without a half-updated read.
to the percentage bucket, never error the call.
Reader in flight when the swap happens keeps its OWN
already-fetched reference -- reads v1 to completion, or v2 if it
started after the swap. Never a mix of the two.
The swap is ONE reference assignment (currentSnapshotRef = newSnapshot) -- not a mutation of fields inside a shared object.
That's the whole concurrency story: nothing is ever partially updated, so nothing needs a lock to read safely.
Two instances evaluating the identical (flagKey, userId) always compute the identical bucket -- consistency by determinism, not coordination.
